question: Does the complete preceding five-number order-statistic geometry contain incremental one-step information about the next draw's position marginals, beyond the exact 5-of-40 order-statistic prior?
hypothesis: A fixed Gaussian kernel over all five standardized order-statistic coordinates improves mean multiclass Brier score over the exact prior on both Validation and historical Blind OOS; a fixed one-dimensional P5-only kernel is a nested diagnostic comparator.

model.training_pairs: u=1..t-1 only; state D[u-1], outcome D[u]; no pair whose outcome is target D[t]
model.selection: Choose one bandwidth by lowest mean five-position multiclass Brier on Validation only; tie-break larger h; no Blind OOS tuning.
model.p5_only_comparator: Same kernel/shrinkage on standardized P5 coordinate only, fixed h=1.5; diagnostic only and not separately tuned.

walk_forward.strict_prior_rule: For target index t, current state is D[t-1]; historical transition u may be used only when 1<=u<=t-1.

endpoints.primary: Mean five-position multiclass Brier gain = exact_prior_Brier - candidate_Brier; positive favors candidate.
endpoints.secondary: Mean Top-5 position-hit gain = candidate_hits - exact_prior_top5_hits; positive favors candidate.
endpoints.diagnostic: P5 Brier difference full-state kernel versus fixed P5-only kernel.

inference.multiple_testing: Holm correction across all 4 bandwidths x 2 Blind OOS endpoints (8 tests).
inference.confidence_interval: Percentile 95% circular moving-block bootstrap of paired per-target gains.
inference.test: One-sided block sign-flip, alternative candidate gain > 0; contiguous blocks are sign-flipped as units.

controls: Identical targets and target outcomes across all candidates.
Strict-prior cutoff assertions for every target.
Probability normalization and domain checks for all 5 positions.
Deterministic seeds and canonical result serialization.
limitations_preregistered: Historical Blind OOS is prior-exposed to other SONAR research and is not a virgin prospective holdout.
Marginal position forecasts do not define a coherent joint 5-number distribution.
A positive historical result would remain exploratory until a separate prospective freeze.
Block sign-flip inference assumes exchangeability of contiguous 20-target block signs.
No causal, physical-fluid, or future-winning-number claim is made.
